t: Chola (Cola) Empire
x: Abstract The Chola Empire was established in South India in the 9th century and flourished for almost 400 years. Its territorial extent, military strength, institutional structures, and monumental art attest to the power and authority of the dynasty. Starting from modest origins in the fertile uplands along the Kaveri River, the Cholas first extended and consolidated their rule over the entire Tamil macro‐region. Thereafter, they brought contiguous regions as well as far off places under their sway. In the annals of Indian history, the imperial grandeur of the Cholas remains an important reference point to assess the sociopolitical and economic institutions in the premodern period.
